description:
Beat the heat with this easy Mango Lassi recipe — a refreshing, creamy Indian yogurt smoothie that’s perfect for summer! 🥭❄️

In this video, Tia from Tasty Treats with Tia shows how anyone (even kids!) can make this classic Mango Lassi at home. It’s smooth, sweet, and packed with tropical flavor. Perfect for family breakfasts, brunches, or a quick summer drink.

🧡 What You’ll Need:
 • Fresh or canned mango pulp
 • Yogurt (curd)
 • Honey or sugar for sweetness
 • Cashews, almonds, or pistachios (optional)
 • Ice cubes for a chilled, café-style lassi

👩‍🍳 Steps:
1️⃣ Add yogurt and mango pulp to a blender
2️⃣ Add nuts, honey, and ice
3️⃣ Blend until smooth and creamy
4️⃣ Pour into a glass and garnish with chopped nuts
5️⃣ Sip, smile, and enjoy your homemade mango lassi!

This recipe is:
✅ Quick & Easy
✅ Kid-Friendly
✅ Perfect for Hot Days
✅ A Healthier Dessert Drink
